name: source-path-rows
goal: Source paths and code actions fit one desktop line and at most two mobile lines

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Desktop path and code action must share one line; mobile allows two. Folder text may truncate; filename and original link remain.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing entity-preview-source matrix verified links, modal and compact actions but not path wrapping or row height. Strengthened its shared fileLink check for no wrapping, full title and responsive row bound.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed ae43049ca; immutable red record retained with Source paths stay on one line failing on normal wrapping in the existing Source matrix.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Shared SourceFileList now uses two grid columns on desktop; folder text truncates before filename. Mobile has one path line plus one compact action line. Full title and accessible path retained.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Immutable green record passes the unchanged four existing service/selection cases on bf62eba2d. Corrected red a43ed1d54 and record bc23c82d retained; all pixel bytes and workload measurements are Git-backed.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
